A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same diffusion-driven patch-selection work. Their complete main text and supplementary material, including equations, nine tables and fifteen figures, are readable and support reliable comparison.

before.justification: v1 reports original classification results for distilled datasets, cross-architecture evaluations, ablations and efficiency measurements in the main text and supplement.

after.justification: v2 retains those original experimental results, including the benchmark comparisons in Tables 1–2 and supplementary efficiency and sensitivity studies.

M1.justification: Algorithm 1 and Sections 3.2–3.5 retain the same diffusion-based patch selection, DIFT clustering and ranking, IPC-dependent reconstruction, and soft-label calibration. The rewritten preliminaries do not change the proposed procedure.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate the same dataset-distillation tasks on CIFAR-10/100, TinyImageNet, ImageNet-1K, ImageNet-100, ImageNette and ImageWoof. No additional dataset, domain or test scenario appears in the supplement.

E2.justification: Table 1 retains SRe2L, Minimax, D4M and RDED. Table 2 retains DSA, IDM, TESLA, DATM, D4M, SRe2L and RDED in their corresponding architecture groups. Supplementary comparator membership is also unchanged; the new citation is not an evaluated baseline.

E3.justification: Sections 4.1–4.2 and the supplement retain the same IPC settings, teacher/student architectures, image preprocessing, patch sizes, soft-label evaluation and ablation configurations. Settings moved by pagination are not additions or revisions.

E4.justification: The clustering-feature and image-count ablations are unchanged, as are the supplementary timestep, cluster-count, resizing, cross-architecture and t-SNE analyses. Their questions, configurations and supporting evidence are retained.

E5.justification: Both versions specify five randomly initialized evaluation networks in Section 4.1 and retain the same average and plus/minus reporting. No run-count, seed, uncertainty-estimation or significance-testing information is added or revised.

E6.justification: The matched numerical results and qualitative visualizations are unchanged throughout both PDFs. For example, Table 1 retains OursS accuracies of 59.4 ± 0.2 for ResNet-18 and 65.4 ± 0.7 for ResNet-101 on ImageNet-1K at IPC=50. Supplementary results are likewise identical.

T1.justification: Equations 2–3 change norm typesetting and explicitly include the subscript 2, retaining the squared-error formulation. The remaining equations and mathematical reasoning are unchanged; no theorem, proof or substantive derivation is added.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction contributions and conclusion retain the same claims about selection rather than generation, unrestricted one-step distillation, reduced distribution mismatch and strong large-scale performance.

C2.justification: The interpretations of clustering, architecture transfer, timestep choice, resizing and t-SNE results remain unchanged. Discussions of runtime overhead and weak ViT performance with limited samples are also retained.

D1.justification: The reported diffusion settings, cluster-selection rules, preprocessing, PyTorch implementation and NVIDIA RTX-3090 hardware are unchanged. The supplement retains the same implementation and efficiency details, and no code or data access information is added.

R1.justification: v2 adds Siglidis et al., Diffusion models as data mining tools, to Section 2.2 and the references. It removes Kingma and Welling's Auto-encoding variational Bayes reference alongside the deleted VAE background passage. The positioning against dataset-distillation methods otherwise remains unchanged.

P1.justification: Sections 2.2 and 3.1 receive localized rewrites, including removal of the brief VAE and latent-diffusion efficiency explanation. The overall section order, method narrative, experimental discussion and supplementary prose are otherwise retained.

P2.justification: Figure 4 moves from the upper-right column to below Figure 3 in the left column on page 5. Subsequent text reflows, and references begin on page 8 rather than page 9. Figure content, captions and table structures remain unchanged.

improvement.justification: v2 mainly rewrites background prose, clarifies loss notation, exchanges background citations and adjusts layout. These limited edits preserve the method, experimental evidence, supplementary analyses and reproducibility information. They do not establish a meaningful net improvement or deterioration in overall paper quality.
